aiOverview.content: casualty/ˈkaZH(əw)əltē/Casualty is the world’s longest-running primetime medical drama, broadcast on BBC One since 1986 and currently airing its 40th/41st series, with a focus on high-stakes emergency department (ED) storylines in Holby. Centered on hospital staff and paramedics, the show explores dramatic medical cases and complex personal lives, featuring recurring characters like Faith Dean and Matty Linlaker. The series is primarily filmed at the BBC’s Roath Lock Studios in Cardiff.Key Details About CasualtySeasons: Casualty is highly prolific, with over 40 series/series-worth of episodes aired as of April 2026. It is known for its intense, often shocking storylines, covering medical emergencies, ethical dilemmas, and dramatic character departures, such as the recent death of character Kim Chang.Main Cast (2026): Key characters often highlighted include Faith Dean, Matty Linlaker, and others tackling crises like the "lethal" virus storyline starting in series 41.Memorable Moments: With thousands of episodes, memorable moments include numerous high-stakes "disaster" episodes, major character departures, and intense personal storylines for the medical staff.Filming Location: Casualty is filmed in Cardiff, Wales, at the BBC's dedicated Roath Lock Studios, where the set for Holby General Hospital is based.Casualty is available to watch in the UK on BBC iPlayer.
